questions.stem: How do the liver and kidneys work together in excretion?

options.text: The liver filters waste from the blood and the kidneys store it
The liver produces urea from excess amino acids and the kidneys filter it from the blood
The kidneys produce urea and the liver breaks it down further
The liver and kidneys both produce carbon dioxide for the lungs to excrete

questions.explanation: The liver and kidneys have complementary roles in excretion. The liver produces urea through deamination of excess amino acids, and the kidneys then filter this urea from the blood and excrete it in urine.
